mapper.update: WITH recent AS (SELECT id FROM work WHERE state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND year >= #{fromYear}), total AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM recent), fresh AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT wn.name_string_id, count(DISTINCT wn.work_id)::int AS works, (count(DISTINCT wn.work_id)::double precision / total.n)::real AS share FROM work_name wn JOIN recent r ON r.id = wn.work_id, total WHERE NOT wn.only_reference GROUP BY wn.name_string_id, total.n), del AS (DELETE FROM name_ubiquity u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh f WHERE f.name_string_id = u.name_string_id) AND coalesce(u.scored_share, 0) = 0), zero AS (UPDATE name_ubiquity u SET works = 0, share = 0, computed_at = now() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh f WHERE f.name_string_id = u.name_string_id) AND coalesce(u.scored_share, 0) > 0) INSERT INTO name_ubiquity (name_string_id, works, share, computed_at) SELECT name_string_id, works, share, now() FROM fresh ON CONFLICT (name_string_id) DO UPDATE SET works = excluded.works, share = excluded.share, computed_at = excluded.computed_at

WITH fresh AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT t.taxon_id, w.year, count(DISTINCT wn.work_id)::int AS works, (count(DISTINCT wn.work_id) FILTER (WHERE wn.main_subject))::int AS main_subject_works FROM work_name wn JOIN work w ON w.id = wn.work_id AND w.state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND w.year IS NOT NULL CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(wn.taxon_path) AS t(taxon_id) WHERE NOT wn.only_reference GROUP BY t.taxon_id, w.year), del AS (DELETE FROM taxon_stats s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh f WHERE f.taxon_id = s.taxon_id AND f.year = s.year)) INSERT INTO taxon_stats (taxon_id, year, works, main_subject_works) SELECT taxon_id, year, works, main_subject_works FROM fresh ON CONFLICT (taxon_id, year) DO UPDATE SET works = excluded.works, main_subject_works = excluded.main_subject_works
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM name_ubiquity u WHERE
mapper.update: UPDATE name_ubiquity u SET scored_share = u.share WHERE true
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM name_ubiquity WHERE share = 0 AND scored_share = 0
